title: A new question typed after an answer (another layer, another goal). It gets give_answer, a fresh read and steps on the new layer, and doesn't recite the first answer

turns.say: Now how do I make Subtitle fade in slower?

note: Spec 014 T078 (FR-031). The second turn is plain text, as the panel sends the follow-up bar; the tool's kind decides it is a new question. 'Title' is banned from the second answer: Subtitle is not parented to it (its parent is CTRL), so the name could only come from reciting. Two answers with steps write two asked entries (FR-038).
